summary.oneLiner: and PNB is front-running peers by pre-provisioning for ECL, a prudence some retail investors questioned but management strongly defended.

one-line thesis: A textbook PSU turnaround-consolidation quarter: net profit INR 5,253 cr, ROA 1.04%, ROE 17.33%, GNPA down 100 bps YoY to 2.78% and NNPA 0.28% with a sector-leading 97.23% PCR — while management deliberately shrinks the balance sheet's low-yield tail (INR 22,411 cr IBPC + ~INR 35,000 cr sub-7% corporate advances shed) so that headline advances +12.7% understates core growth of +15.4%. NIM is inflecting up (domestic 2.61%→2.64%, global 2.47%→2.50%) with the repricing of high-cost deposits done, and PNB is front-running peers by pre-provisioning for ECL (INR 390 cr floating this quarter, INR 2,435 cr total) — a prudence some retail investors questioned but management strongly defended.
financial scorecard (track qoq/yoy): > Distortions: headline advances +12.7% suppressed by deliberate IBPC (INR 22,411 cr) + sub-7% corporate (~INR 35,000 cr) run-off → core +15.4%. Opex/employee cost lower YoY on AS-15 provision INR 490 cr (vs INR 1,151 cr) + PSLC-purchase cost INR 360 cr (vs INR 893 cr). Processing fee INR 938 cr (+29% YoY). SMA 2.9% (SMA0 1.55/SMA1 0.62/SMA2 0.73). Gold loan INR 31,888 cr (+103% YoY). LCR 135%.
guidance (critical — verify next quarter: Growth / margin: QoQ NIM improvement to continue every quarter as low-yield IBPC/corporate run off; on track to FY27 guidance; core RAM engines — retail +17.5%, MSME +19.8% (targeting ~25%), agri +16.4%; corporate +10%. Sanction pipeline INR 1.38 lakh cr pending disbursement.
Asset quality: GNPA <2.5%, NNPA <0.3% (already 0.28%), PCR >96%, slippage ratio <0.9% (at 0.68%) — all FY27.
FCNR-B: target USD 2.5 billion; USD 425 mn done (of which ~USD 200 mn via leverage); CRR/SLR-exempt → lowers cost of deposits over time.
Cost-to-income: target 47-48% by FY27-end (from 50.31%).
Gold loan: grow to INR 59,000-60,000 cr by FY27-end (from INR 32,000 cr); 3,400 branches added (now ~6,400 doing gold).
PSLC: next FY no purchase needed; aim to be a net seller of INR 5,000-10,000 cr (agri gold-loan +100% closing the priority-sector gap).
ECL (effective 1-Apr-2027): one-time transition INR 9,500-10,000 cr (net of ~INR 2,435 cr floating ≈ INR 7,000-7,500 cr); ~10-12 bps/quarter recurring credit-cost impact; ample capital cushion.
IL&FS Tamil Nadu Power: ~INR 1,000 cr excess provision to be written back in Q2/Q3 FY27 (all approvals in place).
Treasury income: INR 900-1,000 cr per quarter outlook (INR 1,100 cr this quarter).
Recovery: total INR 13,000 cr FY27 (of which ~INR 4,000 cr via technical-write-off route).
Network / capex: 250 new branches (south + west focus); IT/digital budget ~INR 3,400 cr FY27; +INR 1 lakh cr cumulative digital-loan sanctions this year.
order book & pipeline (loan pipeline / g: Q1 sanctions >INR 95,500 cr; INR 1.38 lakh cr pending disbursement → strong forward visibility.
Digital credit sanctions INR 19,000+ cr in Q1; every 2nd loan now sanctioned digitally (was every 3rd); on track for +INR 1 lakh cr cumulative digital sanctions this FY.
MSME driven by digital cash-flow-based lending + CGTMSE (75% cover); SIDBI-estimated INR 25-27 lakh cr sector credit gap = long runway.
segment / subsidiary detail: Corporate book INR 5.15 lakh cr: Infra 9%, Energy 4%, Roads/ports 4%, Food-processing 2%, Iron & steel ~2%, Metal products 1.8%. 86% of rated exposures >INR 25 cr are A+, 52% AAA.
Personal loans INR 23,727 cr — 100% salaried (policy: no non-salaried PL). No stress from IT-sector/AI turmoil.
Gold loan INR 31,888 cr (+103% YoY) — the standout growth + PSLC-gap lever.
Subsidiaries (PNB Housing/MetLife/Gilts): no stake enhancement planned; focus on value maximisation, board interventions, PNB Housing new MD driving activity.
growth verticals / optionality: Balance-sheet rejig as an earnings lever: shedding sub-7% advances + IBPC and replacing with higher-yield RAM lifts NII/NIM even at modest headline growth.
Gold loan doubling to close the PSLC gap and flip PNB from PSLC-buyer (INR ~900 cr cost) to seller — a structural cost-to-income tailwind.

Digital/AI/Quantum: AI chatbots PIHU (customer) & RAHI (employee), GenAI credit-note & CRM tools; quantum-safe encryption on 86 customer-facing apps (NIST-certified), quantum mule-detection — efficiency + risk edge.
Credit cards, cash-management, supply-chain finance flagged as emerging fee/diversification engines.
margins & cost dynamics: High-cost deposit repricing completed by May; PNB out of bulk-deposit & CD markets; cost of deposits −34 bps YoY. FCNR (CRR/SLR-exempt) to lower funding cost further.
Cost-to-income 50.31% (from 55.31%) with clear 47-48% target — helped by falling PSLC purchase cost and AS-15 normalisation; NII/NIM up each quarter as low-yield tail runs off.
capex / expansion (watch slippage): 250 new branches FY27 (south/west tilt); new high-tech Gurgaon data centre; ~INR 3,400 cr IT/digital budget (82-84% of last year's INR 3,500 cr utilised). 3,400 branches added to gold-loan network.
capital allocation: CRAR 18.13% / CET1 14.52% — large cushion; prudent floating-provision build (INR 390 cr/qtr, INR 2,435 cr total) to pre-fund ECL; IL&FS TN Power ~INR 1,000 cr write-back as a "kitty" for FY27. Subsidiary value-maximisation over stake changes.
risks & watch-items: Monsoon / El Niño: MD concedes a bad kharif would be "a big challenge" across agri and agri-linked income — the key macro swing (watch Aug-Sep).

ECL adoption 1-Apr-27: INR 9,500-10,000 cr one-time + 10-12 bps/qtr recurring; front-loaded floating provisioning muting QoQ profit (drew retail-investor pushback on optics/share price — mgmt defended as prudent).
NIM sustainability at 2.5% global vs private-bank compression debate; growth optically lagging other PSUs due to balance-sheet clean-up.
Geopolitical / sector stress (textile/chemical/steel) — none visible yet; SMA among lowest in years (2.9%).
management quality / tone: Confident, granular, guidance-forward MD (Ashok Chandra) who quantifies almost everything and repeatedly frames profitability + asset-quality + efficiency as the top agenda (built into field-staff KPIs). Strong, principled defence of quarterly ECL pre-provisioning against a retail investor's share-price complaint ("very, very prudent… someone has to take the hit"). Transparent on the low-yield run-off strategy and its optical drag on headline growth.
non-obvious takeaways: Headline advances +12.7% badly understates the business: core (ex-IBPC) is +15.4%, and management is choosing slower headline growth by shedding ~INR 57,000 cr of low-yield IBPC+corporate to protect NII/NIM.
Gold-loan doubling isn't just growth — it's the mechanism to eliminate ~INR 900 cr/yr PSLC purchase cost and turn PNB into a PSLC seller, a direct cost-to-income lever.

PNB is ahead of peers on ECL: it will enter 1-Apr-27 with the transition largely pre-funded (net ~INR 7-7.5k cr after floating), so the adoption should be a non-event vs banks provisioning it as a one-off shock.
Fresh-underwriting quality proof point: INR 12.92 lakh cr disbursed over the last 6 years carries just INR 5,486 cr NPA (0.42%) — the post-clean-up book is very clean.
IL&FS TN Power INR 1,000 cr write-back is a known FY27 profit "kitty" to be deployed in Q2/Q3.
challenges → beneficiaries & losers (lis: > Challenges raised were bank/macro-level (ECL transition, monsoon/El Niño, low-yield run-off). None map to a beneficiary within our own industrials-heavy companies.csv/products.csv; other banks are peers, not resolvable beneficiaries. Left largely blank per "leave blank if unresolved."
qoq change log (fill each quarter): Q1 FY27 (this): Business INR 29.98 lakh cr (+10.2% YoY); advances INR 12.73 lakh cr (+12.7% / +15.4% ex-IBPC), deposits INR 17.25 lakh cr (+8.5%). Net profit INR 5,253 cr; ROA 1.04%, ROE 17.33%; NII INR 10,798 cr (+4% QoQ); domestic NIM 2.64% (+3 bps), global 2.50%. GNPA 2.78% (−100 bps YoY), NNPA 0.28%, PCR 97.23%, slippage 0.68%; CRAR 18.13%, CET1 14.52%. Shed INR 22,411 cr IBPC + ~INR 35,000 cr sub-7% corporate. Gold loan INR 31,888 cr (+103%). C/I 50.31% (from 55.31%). Floating provision +INR 390 cr → INR 2,435 cr. Guidance: FCNR USD 2.5 bn (USD 425 mn done); GNPA<2.5%/NNPA<0.3%/PCR>96%/slippage<0.9%; C/I 47-48% by FY-end; gold loan INR 59-60k cr by FY-end; ECL one-time INR 9.5-10k cr + 10-12 bps/qtr; IL&FS TN Power INR 1,000 cr write-back Q2/Q3; treasury INR 900-1,000 cr/qtr; recovery INR 13,000 cr (INR 4,000 cr TWO); MSME ~25%; +INR 1 lakh cr digital sanctions; 250 branches; IT budget INR 3,400 cr; PSLC net-seller INR 5-10k cr next FY.

next Q → check: NIM QoQ step-up; FCNR-B toward USD 2.5 bn; gold-loan ramp toward INR 60k cr; C/I toward 47-48%; IL&FS write-back booked; ECL final digital calc (October); monsoon/El Niño agri impact; slippage/PCR vs guidance; IBPC fully run off.
